todo_line: - [ ] 007 Wire explicit targeted Add through the existing admission and welcome flow with confirmation-time actor and target rechecks, idempotent already-member behaviour, no duplicate welcome, and the approved Cancel, Escape, success-announcement, and focus transitions; focused-test lost authority and stale membership.
outcome: The accepted targeted Members-page preview gains one explicit Add confirmation that rechecks current actor and target facts through the existing admission boundary, sends the existing welcome only for a new transition, and completes the approved Cancel, Escape, success-announcement, and focus behavior without changing scanner-safe GET semantics.
scope: Add stable Add and Cancel controls to the accepted targeted panel when its authoritative preview says the target is not already a member. Keep the existing already-member state non-actionable.

Handle targeted confirmation separately from the ordinary picker action. Ignore browser-supplied actor, club, group, person, and membership identities: use the authenticated current member and route-selected group/person, and call `Membership.resolve_custom_group_target_authoritatively/3` again at confirmation to obtain current server-owned club, group, person, membership, and participation facts.

Dispatch `Membership.add_custom_group_member/2` with the freshly resolved target identity and authenticated actor. Rely on `Memba.Membership.Club` to recheck current actor participation or Admin authority and target active club membership at the write boundary, including when the displayed LiveView is stale.

Reuse the existing `CustomGroupAdmission` and group-welcome flow. Deliver one ordinary welcome only for `transition: :member_added`; treat `:already_member` as a successful idempotent no-op with no additional event or welcome. Use resolver-owned club and group facts for targeted welcome copy and URL context rather than stale projected group copy.

After a new addition, close the targeted routed state on the ordinary `/groups/:group_id/members` URL, refresh the member list, render a stable `role="status"` and `aria-live="polite"` success announcement, and focus only the newly admitted member row.

Make Cancel and Escape leave the targeted URL-addressable state without mutation or welcome, return to the ordinary Members URL, and return focus to `#member-section-action-add-group-member` using the project's LiveView patch and JS-command patterns.

Add focused regressions for successful Add and welcome, already-member and retry idempotence, stale displayed actor authority, target club departure after preview, generic denied-action behavior, Cancel and Escape, semantic success announcement, and conditional row focus. Preserve every accepted task-006 route, privacy, authoritative-copy, sign-in, and inert-GET case.
scope_exclusions: Do not add an aggregate-backed actor check to GET or require immediate denial of a read-only preview while display projections lag. Current authority and target eligibility are mandatory at Add, not a new GET policy.

Do not trust event parameters or a stale presentation assign as target identity at confirmation, widen general web composition, create request or approval state, or introduce a new membership, welcome, retry, delivery-status, or authorization model.

Do not change the route shape, sign-in return, generic protected-detail denials, resolver contract, aggregate admission rules, general custom-group picker/removal behavior, or scanner-safe disconnected GET and connected mount.

Do not send a welcome for an already-member result, roll back committed membership when welcome delivery fails, add bespoke provider-recovery UI, or weaken the existing generic stale-action error behavior.
Do not add a client hook or LiveComponent when existing LiveView patches and JS commands can express the URL and focus transitions.
Do not edit or enable acceptance feature scenarios, implement browser journey steps, alter the approved plan or ADRs, or perform task 008 browser work.
Do not run `dev check`, `dev check --quick`, `dev ci`, either complete acceptance layer, or another unscoped full-suite command; task 009 owns the exact-state iteration gate.

references.facts: GET remains a projection-gated read-only preview, while explicit Add must recheck current actor authority and target active membership, invoke the existing admission and welcome flow, avoid duplicate membership and welcome, and provide the approved keyboard, announcement, and focus transitions.

The approved interaction has Add and Cancel, an announced success followed by the new member row, an already-member no-op, Escape cancellation, focus return to ordinary Add member, and focus on the admitted row after success.

The LiveView already owns targeted route state and the ordinary picker admission/welcome sequence. Add a distinct targeted confirmation using a fresh authoritative target resolution, and factor shared admission follow-up only as needed without accepting client identities.

The accepted targeted panel has stable IDs and an empty actions container. Existing picker and removal interactions demonstrate Escape plus focus-return JS commands; member-row focus must be conditional to the just-admitted person.
The targeted panel precedes the ordinary picker and member list, already receives resolver-owned group copy, and has an existing ordinary Add-member focus target.

The resolver returns authoritative club/group summaries, the target's current active membership identity, and current participation. Admission returns `CustomGroupAdmission` distinguishing `:member_added` from `:already_member` without a projection race.
The Club aggregate is the existing authoritative write boundary for current actor authority, active target identity, custom-group validity, and duplicate-add idempotence.

The existing provider-neutral welcome expects resolved club, group, recipient, actor, and ordinary group URL; deciding whether a transition warrants delivery remains the admitting application flow's responsibility.
Extend this focused file while retaining its accepted sign-in, display-authority, privacy, resolver-copy, heading, selected-person, already-member, and no-mutation GET coverage.
Keep the existing ordinary picker and outside-admin flow passing, especially one welcome for a new admission, none on idempotent retry, immediate fresh membership, and provider-failure behavior.

Use component-level selector and JS-command assertions for stable targeted controls, Escape, patch/focus behavior, semantic status, and conditional row focus where LiveViewTest cannot prove the browser's active element.
Close the targeted mode with a LiveView patch to the ordinary Members URL; do not hide durable routed state only in the client DOM.
Current club membership and Admin role decisions belong at the Club write boundary, so stale display permission cannot authorize Add.
Current participation governs group activity, and stale actions receive the existing generic authorization error.
Use route-driven state, LiveView patches, stable element IDs, JS commands, and selector-based focused tests.

constraints: Preserve the task-006 read/write boundary: disconnected GET and connected mount remain inert, and no membership or welcome occurs until explicit Add.

Confirmation must perform a fresh authoritative target resolution. The route and authenticated session identify intent; client event payloads and stale assigns do not supply actor, club, group, person, or membership authority.

The Club aggregate remains the final authority. A stale page shown to a recently revoked Admin or departed group participant must not authorize Add, and a target who left the club after preview must not be admitted.

A missing, invalid, cross-club, built-in, or inactive target at confirmation and a no-longer-authorized actor must produce the existing generic behavior with no `GroupMemberAdded` event and no welcome.
A newly committed admission remains committed if welcome delivery fails; preserve existing logging and generic UI behavior.

The success and cancellation transitions must keep the URL truthful. Focus markup or commands must target only the ordinary Add-member control on cancellation and the newly added member row on success, without globally autofocusing all member rows.
Keep task 007 bounded to focused LiveView/component wiring and regressions. The acceptance journey, browser-level `activeElement` proof, and full iteration gate remain tasks 008 and 009.
completion_evidence_required: List every changed path and identify the targeted Add event, the confirmation-time authoritative resolver call, the existing admission dispatch, and the new versus already-member welcome branch.
Show focused proof that opening or reconnecting to the targeted route remains mutation-free and that only explicit Add creates exactly one matching admission event and one ordinary welcome.
Show that browser-supplied identity fields are not trusted and that the welcome and success copy use freshly resolved server-owned target, club, and group facts.
Show stale-page tests for lost actor authority and target club departure at confirmation, each with generic denial, zero target admission events, zero welcome emails, and no accidental membership.
Show idempotent already-member behavior with no Add control or duplicate event/welcome, including a confirmation race or retry rather than only static rendering.
Show Cancel and Escape patch to the ordinary Members URL, close the targeted panel without mutation, and encode focus return to `#member-section-action-add-group-member`.
Show successful admission closes targeted mode, refreshes the member list, renders the stable polite status announcement, and gives only the admitted member row the focus contract.
Confirm all accepted task-006 focused cases and ordinary admission/component regressions still pass; confirm no acceptance feature or browser-journey files changed.
Record each focused validation command, working directory, exit status, test and failure counts, and any unresolved issue. Do not report `dev check` for this packet.

latest_review.summary: The accepted prerequisite established the authenticated targeted route, projection-backed display gate, authoritative same-club target resolution, resolver-owned group copy, generic protected-detail denial, focused read-only panel, already-member state, and mutation-free GET. Its review reserves authoritative revocation and stale-target checks for task 007's explicit Add boundary.

latest_worker_result.summary: The accepted worker revision carried resolver-owned group name into the targeted panel and passed all eight focused targeted-route tests without adding Add handling, welcome dispatch, Cancel or Escape, success transition, acceptance changes, or browser work.
